items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: they had a guitar player by the name -- his name was Snaggs from Detroit

ctx.x: Yes. I knew his first wife. Yeah. But any way, we went to Kelly's Stables, 51st Street, and let's see who was appearing there then? The Harlem Highlanders. Baby Lawrence, and who almost literally danced up the wall. Oh, they had a tremendous group. Baby Lawrence, they had a guitar player by the name -- his name was Snaggs from Detroit, and another singer, a very talented guy that played bass. His last name was Glover, I don't remember his first name. But so talented.

But we stayed here quite a while, at the Kelly's Stables there. This is when all the pimps and all the hustlers would hang out there. You'd see all the prostitutes. They would bring -- the madams would bring all the girls in and set them around the table. And I could tell you some stories about Jackie Gill, our old favorite. You remember Jackie Gill? This is when I met Jackie Gill. He was one of the boys.
